services.name: Farming Exhibit
services.desc: Between 2017 and 2020 we have created an outdoor exhibition space that spans a boardwalk where you can take “A Walk Through Time” reading eight interpretive signs explaining and illustrating the island’s early settlement and social and economic development. Funding for “A Walk Through Time” was provided by a Federal Canada 150 Sesquicentennial Grant. The mosaic was a sesquicentennial art project of the island’s GMCS graduating class of 2017, and was funded by a Federal Canada 150 Sesquicentennial grant. services.name: Rental Facilities
services.desc: Our large lecture hall is named after a founding board member and early president of the board, Elmer Wilcox. The Wilcox family is one of the island's oldest founding families. They settled in Deep Cove where they had a shipbuilding business in the early 1800s. This hall is where the Museum's Evening Programmes & many of its Special Events are held. (insert hyperlink to the Schedule page) Programming takes place throughout July & August on Tuesday and Thursday evenings, and on other evenings for special events such as book launches, art workshops, and music concerts (insert hyperlink to EVENTS).
